about: How common each natal aspect is at birth: the share of days from 1 January 1930 to 31 December 2009 (12:00 UT) on which the two bodies stood within the orb of the exact angle. Orb 8° when the Sun or Moon is one of them, 6° otherwise. Positions from AGS's ephemeris: astronomy-engine (geocentric, true ecliptic of date), Chiron's integrated orbit, the true node, and the mean Black Moon Lilith (Meeus, Astronomical Algorithms, 2nd ed., ch. 47). periods: the months a pair of slow bodies was in orb (gaps under 90 days joined), for the pages of two slow bodies.
